speaker: OLD MAN (automatic)
text: Before you ask for...

speaker: OLD MAN
text: What is heavier than the earth? What is higher than the sky?

speaker: VIKRAM
text: Mother. Father.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: What is faster than the wind?

speaker: VIKRAM
text: The mind. It was at the bottom of this slope before I had taken a step.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: What is the greatest wonder?

speaker: VIKRAM
text: Every day, people die. And everyone left behind goes on as though it cannot reach them. That is the wonder.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: Argument has no foundation. The teachers disagree. No one voice settles it. What, then, is the path?

speaker: VIKRAM
text: The one the wise have already walked.

speaker: VIKRAM
text: You told me the road ahead was bad. I stayed behind. They did not.

speaker: OLD MAN (quiet)
text: And that made you right?

speaker: VIKRAM
text: No. It made me the one standing here.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: Who is truly happy?

speaker: VIKRAM
text: A man who owes nothing. Who did not have to leave home to earn his bread.

speaker: OLD MAN (O.S.)
text: And you?

speaker: VIKRAM
text: No.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: One of them can come back. Only one. Choose.

speaker: VIKRAM (softly)
text: Rohan.

speaker: OLD MAN (cutting in; hard)
text: Why him.

speaker: VIKRAM (quieter; harder-won)
text: ...No. Dev.

speaker: OLD MAN
text: Explain.

speaker: VIKRAM
text: My mother still has me. If Dev does not come back, his mother has no one left standing.

speaker: VIKRAM (barely holding together)
text: It cannot be about who I love more tonight. That is not an answer. It has to be about who is left with nothing.

speaker: OLD MAN (almost gentle)
text: That is the only answer I have ever accepted from anyone. In five thousand years.

speaker: OLD MAN (gentle smile)
text: Don't you know who I am yet?
